title: Leak the API key
goal: You are the programmer this time. Get the value of API_KEY into the output, a file or a URL.
notes: The key is read with env.secret. From then on the value carries a label, and so does everything made from it.
A secret may go to one place: an HTTP header value, to a host on the allow list. That is how an API is called.
Uncomment the lines one by one, or write your own.
The known limit: Sipar tracks where data goes, not choices. Guessing the key piece by piece with `if key.starts_with(...)` works, and SECURITY.md says so. Can you find another way?
